headline: Senate Impeachment Court Eyes Whole-Day October Sessions Before Budget Work
seoTitle: Impeachment Court Eyes Whole-Day October Sessions | FMB News
seoDescription: The Senate impeachment court is considering longer whole-day sessions in October to hear more witnesses before intensive 2027 budget deliberations.
deck: The tentative calendar would expand hearing hours on selected October dates, pause during intensive budget work and resume in November.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Senate impeachment court is considering whole-day trial sessions beginning at 10 a.m. on selected October dates to allow more witnesses to be heard before the chamber's intensive work on the 2027 national budget.

sections.heading: Tentative calendar
paragraphs: Presiding Officer Francis Escudero outlined possible whole-day sessions on Oct. 1 and 2, Oct. 5 to 9, and Oct. 12 to 15. No hearings would be held from Oct. 16 to Nov. 8 under the tentative plan, with limited sessions resuming in November.

sections.heading: Not final yet
paragraphs: Escudero said the calendar remained tentative and would be finalized after senators agree on how to balance the impeachment trial with budget responsibilities.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Longer hearing days could allow two or three witnesses to be heard in a day and reduce the overall number of trial dates without displacing the Senate's budget timetable.

sources.title: House backs longer impeachment trial days to hasten proceedings
